paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: a left-sidebar gallery of every file the assistant generated across all conversations
# dsh-conversation-files
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web plugin: a left-sidebar entry that gathers **every file the assistant ge
nerated for you — across all conversations** — into one gallery panel, grouped by file type.
Click 对话文件 (folder icon, below SSH) in the left sidebar to open the panel.
> 中文版: README.zh.md
## What shows up
The panel replays the event log of every conversation in the profile and keeps only files the assist
ys the event log of every conversation in the profile and keeps only files the assistant *produced*:
| kind | where it comes from |

| 写入 / Written | files written, edited or patched by tools (`write`, `edit`, `apply_patch`, …) |
| 交
付 / Delivered | files handed over by `present`-style tools |
Read-only touches (`read`, `view_image`, …) and user attachments are deliberately **not** generated
files and never appear here.
Files are grouped by extension:
| group | extensions |

| 图片 / Images | png jpg jpeg webp gif svg bmp avif ico |
| 文档 / Documents | md mdx txt rtf pdf doc d

ocx docm dot dotx odt pages epub |
| 表格 / Spreadsheets | xls xlsx xlsm xlsb numbers ods csv tsv |
|

演示文稿 / Slides | ppt pptx pptm pps ppsx pot potx key odp |
| 代码 / Code | js mjs cjs ts tsx jsx py rb

go rs java kt c cc cpp h hpp cs swift sh bash zsh ps1 css scss less html htm vue lua php |
| 配置 / Co

nfig | json jsonc json5 yaml yml toml ini conf cfg env gitignore plist lock |
| 数据 / Data | jsonl nd

json xml parquet sqlite db sql |
| 压缩包 / Archives | zip tar gz tgz bz2 xz 7z rar dmg iso |
| 音视频 / M

edia | mp3 wav m4a flac aac ogg opus mp4 mov mkv webm avi |
| 其他 / Other | everything else (e.g. ttf

p3 wav m4a flac aac ogg opus mp4 mov mkv webm avi |
| 其他 / Other | everything else (e.g. ttf woff) |
Each card opens with a **preview thumbnail**:
| card type | thumbnail |

| images | the image itself, downscaled by the browser |
| code, text, config | the first 8 lines of

the file in a small monospace block, faded at the bottom |
| markdown | the same, with heading mark

ers, list bullets and emphasis stripped so it reads like prose |
| PDF / Word / PowerPoint / Excel /

iWork | the first page, rendered on demand by macOS QuickLook |
| everything else (archives, media,
binaries) | a large extension label plus a type icon |
Every card carries the extension in its top-right corner and shows the conversation it came from (pl
us `+N` when more conversations touched it), how many times it was written, its size and the time of
the last write. The full path is in the tooltip.

## How it works

- **Host** (`lib/index.js`)
- `GET /dsh-conversation-files/generated` — `sessionQuery.listSessions()
` → skip `origin: 'subagent'` → batch titles via `readTitleSnapshots` → read each log (live sessions
from memory, persisted ones via `readSession`) → parse only `tool/call` arguments (never `tool/resu
lt`, whose `meta.path` is the *operated-on* file) → canonicalise paths with `realpathSync` → merge p

er path across conversations → `stat` the first 400 → sort by last write, newest first.
- `GET /dsh-
conversation-files/thumb?path=…` — returns image bytes only for files that appear in the most recent

scan, only for image extensions, only up to 12 MB.
- `GET /dsh-conversation-files/text?path=…` — th
e first 40 lines of a generated text file (≤ 256 KB, binary files rejected), used for the code/markd

own previews.
- `GET /dsh-conversation-files/preview?path=…&size=…` — a page thumbnail for a generat
ed document, rendered with `qlmanage -t` and cached in `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-conversation-files/previews
/` (one PNG + one JSON of `{mtimeMs,size}` per file, keyed by path hash and size), memory-cached per

process.
- `GET /dsh-conversation-files/raw?path=…` — original bytes (images, PDF, audio/video) for

the in-panel viewer.
- `GET /dsh-conversation-files/apps?path=…` — the applications that can open a
generated file, best match first (JXA + `NSWorkspace.URLsForApplicationsToOpenURL`), cached per ext

ension for 10 minutes.
- `POST /dsh-conversation-files/open`, `/open-with` (with or without an expli
cit `app=`), `/reveal`, `/trash` — the card actions above; every one validates the path against the

current snapshot first.
- All routes reject cross-site requests through `connection.requestRejection

`.
- **Client** (`client/client.js`) — registers `sidebar.panellist` (id `conversation-files`, order
50) and the matching `main` panel; polls the route, buckets files by `group`, and renders sticky gr
oup headers with a responsive card grid.
Caching happens at three levels, so the panel is never stuck on a loading screen for long:
[该节后续省略]

## Limits
- Files written through `bash` redirections (`>`, `tee`, …) are invisible — that is not a structured

write call. Only tool arguments are parsed.
- A file with a `.conf` / `.lock` extension lands in 配置
; unknown extensions (fonts, binaries) land in 其他.

The bundle is linked into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and listed in `dsh.profile.bundle
s`, so it survives a restart. Removing the bundle from the profile removes the sidebar entry.
### Requirements
- macOS, for the QuickLook thumbnails (`qlmanage`), the Trash move (`~/.Trash`) and the app list / o
pen-with picker (`osascript` + `NSWorkspace`). The gallery itself, the text previews and the filters

work anywhere.
- DSH with a `web` client bundle — no extra dependencies.
